DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteochondritis dissecans.

The patient is a 24-year-old male with a two-month history of increasing left knee pain and swelling that is severe enough to awaken him from sleep. Despite NSAID use, symptoms have persisted, suggesting a mechanical or structural intra-articular pathology rather than a simple soft tissue injury. Given his age and the chronic, night-pain nature of the symptoms, I would like to request images of the left knee to confirm the diagnosis.
